{"subject":"Quick hello from Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

I've been thinking about Neon lately and wanted to check in to see how things are going on your end.

If it would be useful, I'd love to grab 20 minutes to catch up. I'm happy to hear what you're focused on and share anything we're seeing across the infrastructure space that might be helpful. No agenda beyond that.

Let me know if a time in the next couple of weeks works.

Best,
Daniel"}
